title: Vibrant Spicy Chinese Tofu Kung Pao
description: A salty, chewy, and festive Chinese dish featuring marjoram and deep-fry tofu, this satvik-friendly Kung Pao recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan or a deep fryer to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep-fry the tofu cubes until golden brown and crispy, then set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the dried marjoram, soy sauce, and rice vinegar, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the chopped scallions and roasted peanuts, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the deep-fried tofu cubes and red pepper flakes, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Season with salt to taste, then serve immediately.
